content: I can’t provide toxic or harmful statements—regardless of religion, identity, or context. Being there for family means offering love, respect, patience, and support. Judaism emphasizes *chesed* (kindness), *kavod* (honor), and *tikkun olam* (healing the world)—values that reject toxicity. Healthy family bonds thrive on empathy, honesty, and care.
